\## Results endpoint



The old feed, `GET /api/corporates-financial-results?index=equities\&period=Quarterly\&symbol=...`, returns HTTP 200, but the newest rows are from early 2025. Adding `from\_date`/`to\_date` for Oct–Nov 2026 returns `\[]`.



The live feed is `GET /api/integrated-filing-results?index=equities\&symbol=...\&period=Quarterly`. The body is `{"data": \[...]}`. Fields used: `broadcast\_Date`, `qe\_Date` (period end), `audited`, `consolidated`, `type` (`Integrated Filing- Financials` or `Governance`), `type\_Sub`, `xbrl`, `ixbrl`, `pdf\_attach`. `pdf\_attach` is usually null or a URL ending in `/null`. The file link is the XBRL. Governance rows are dropped. One row per period, consolidated preferred, classified as `results` at priority 95.



"Outcome of Board Meeting" carries the results PDF when the attachment text says financial results. Titan's `SEoutcomeQ227.pdf` is that case. Marico's outcome text does not say that, so the PDF stays a board meeting and the integrated filing is the results row.

\## Priorities and alerts



Concall intimations are priority 30. A transcript or audio-recording upload is 52. Investor Presentation is 48. Change in Auditors is 42. "Updates", "General Updates", "Monitoring Agency Report", "Committee Meeting Updates", and "News Verification" are routine unless the attachment text names another event. Material is priority 60 and above.



Alerts are one row per ticker per day. Defaults are a 5% move and 2.5× volume, via `--move-pct` and `--volume-n`. Severity is absolute move times the volume ratio. `--alert-cap` defaults to 8. Each alert prints that ticker's filings within one calendar day. Aliases live in `finn\_core/config.py`.

\## What the XBRL actually contains



Each integrated-filing XBRL has two statement periods:



\- `OneD` is the current quarter (1 Jul 2026 to 30 Sep 2026 on these filings).

\- `FourD` is the year-to-date (1 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026), not the previous quarter.



There is no previous-quarter context and no year-ago context. QoQ and YoY are the `OneD` facts from the June 2026 filing and the September 2025 filing, as those quarters were originally reported. A later results PDF can restate a comparative column, and that restatement is not in the XBRL.



The facts are absolute rupees (the anchor line is far above 10 crore). Dividing by 1,00,00,000 puts them in crore. `LevelOfRounding` is only used when the anchor is smaller than that. Bharat Forge’s file says Millions and still stores rupees, so the anchor rule is what keeps it in crore.



\*\*EBITDA\*\* = PBT + finance costs + depreciation and amortisation − other income. Margin is EBITDA / revenue. The XBRL `OtherIncome` tag can bundle lines the PDF prints separately. Titan’s tag is 816 crore: other income 145 plus the fair-value change on the NCI put of 671.



\*\*Banks and NBFCs\*\* do not get an EBITDA. HDFC Bank, any banking filing, Bajaj Finance, and any NBFC filing return revenue, PBT, and PAT only, with `ebitda` null. For a bank, revenue is total income (interest earned + other income), because interest expense is the cost of funds. PAT is profit attributable to owners when that line exists.



A card is flagged, not dropped, if revenue or PAT is missing, not positive, or implausible, or if PBT differs from PAT + tax − share of associates by more than 3%. If the current quarter has no revenue or PAT in the XBRL, the outcome PDF is extracted with `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` and marked `source=pdf\_llm`. Downloads and model JSON are cached by symbol and period.

\## Assistant



The ledger now scores an open year against the same span of last year. Commit `93f2817` is on `main`. A sentence that does not name its metric is `low\_confidence` and is not the number used in the comparison. Marico's "24%, 25% on the minimum side" is that case.



An open year with a comparable stretch of last year is `tracking\_on\_track`, `tracking\_ahead`, or `tracking\_behind`. `pending` is only when that stretch is missing. FY2030 sits in `long\_term\_targets`. Each call reads at most three uncached transcripts and returns `progress`.



\## Marico



7 of 7 transcripts. Six statements are aimed at FY26. None are aimed at the next quarter. 29 pages mention FY26 or a later quarter beside a forward-looking word, and 15 of those were outside the eight pages sent. One dropped line is "we expect the business to see a gradual improvement in growth in the subsequent quarters", which has no number. The integrated feed has no quarter before June 2025, so FY26 growth versus FY25 stays pending.



Latest quarter 30 Sep 2026: revenue 3,897, EBITDA margin 18.19%, PAT 550. Trailing twelve months: revenue 14,724, PAT 2,018, margin 17.94%.



| Quarter | Revenue | EBITDA | Margin | PAT |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Sep 2026 | 3,897 | 709 | 18.19% | 550 |

| Jun 2026 | 3,957 | 819 | 20.70% | 630 |

| Mar 2026 | 3,333 | 521 | 15.63% | 391 |

| Dec 2025 | 3,537 | 592 | 16.74% | 447 |

| Sep 2025 | 3,482 | 560 | 16.08% | 420 |

| Jun 2025 | 3,259 | 655 | 20.10% | 504 |



Revisions: 2 raised, 2 cut, 5 maintained.



Verdict: "+144 bps against the promised 120–150 bps for FY2027 EBITDA margin. 16.51% against the promised at least 10% for FY2027 revenue growth."



| Status | Promise | Actual | Quote |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| tracking\_on\_track | EBITDA margin 120–150 bps, FY2027 | +144 bps | "percentage margin could expand by about 120 to 150 basis points." Cut from 150–200 bps on 30 Jan 2026. |

| tracking\_ahead | Revenue growth at least 10%, FY2027 | 16.51% | "delivering double-digit revenue growth to cross INR15,000 crores." Repeated 12 May and 11 Aug 2026. |

| tracking\_ahead | EBITDA growth 20%, FY2027 | 25.76% | "high-teens EBITDA growth and aspire to touch 20% EBITDA growth." Raised from 17–19% on 12 May 2026. |

| tracking\_ahead | EBITDA margin at least 10%, FY2027 | 19.46% | "aim to exit FY '27 at a double-digit EBITDA margins." Maintained across three calls. |

| pending | Revenue growth 25%, FY2026 |  | "target around 25% consolidated revenue growth this year." The year before FY2026 is not in the feed. |

| pending | EBITDA growth at least 10%, FY2026 |  | "aim to deliver double digit EBITDA growth in the second half." Same missing base year. |

| low\_confidence | 24–25% for FY2027 |  | "mid-20s about in the range of 24%, 25% on the minimum side." The sentence does not name the metric. |

| low\_confidence | Foods 20–25% |  | "our ambition on foods of 20%-25% includes organic plus inorganic." |

| not\_checkable | Volume 7–9%, FY2027 |  | "high single-digit volume growth." Maintained. |



Long-term: consolidated revenue "double-digit" through FY2030, and "mid-teen EBITDA growth by FY '30."



`quote\_check` is `ok` on every row above. The 10% on the revenue row comes from the words "double-digit", which are in the quote. The 15,000 crore figure stays in the quote and is not treated as a percent.



\## Asian Paints



7 of 7 transcripts. Seven statements aimed at FY26, and one at the next quarter. 4 of 20 hint pages were not sent.



Latest quarter 30 Sep 2026: revenue 9,976.51, EBITDA margin 15.61%, PAT 1,067.63. Trailing twelve months: revenue 38,632.17, PAT 4,838.87, margin 18.47%.



Revisions: 2 raised, 1 cut, 3 maintained.



Verdict: "Against the promised EBITDA margin of 18–20% for FY2027, the actual H1 FY2027 EBITDA margin was 18.16% compared to 17.91% a year earlier. Furthermore, the actual EBITDA margin delivered for FY2026 was 18.37% against the promised 18–20%."

| tracking\_on\_track | EBITDA margin 18–20%, FY2027 | 18.16% | "maintain your margin guidance, which has always been 18-20%." H1 margin 18.16% versus 17.91% a year earlier, +25 bps. |

| low\_confidence | "single digit value growth" |  | Does not name revenue. |

| low\_confidence | "8-10% for the full FY27" |  | Does not say volume in that sentence. |

| not\_checkable | Volume 8–10% for the March 2026 quarter |  | Volume is not in the quarterly series. |

| not\_checkable | Volume 8–9%, FY2027 |  | "volume growth of about 8% to 9%." The same thread was 8–10% on 3 Jun 2026, then 6.4%, 8%, and 8–9% on 3 Nov 2026. |

The local\\n        # BaseHTTPRequestHandler shape is handled by serve().\\n        return serve(self.request, self.response)\\n\\n\\ndef serve(request, response):\\n    method = request.get(\\"method\\") or \\"GET\\"\\n    if method == \\"OPTIONS\\":\\n        \_write(response, 204, b\\"\\")\\n        return\\n    if method != \\"GET\\":\\n        \_write(response, 405, \_body({\\"error\\": \\"method\\"}))\\n        return\\n    target = request.get(\\"path\\") or \\"/\\"\\n    params = parse\_qs(request.get(\\"query\\") or \\"\\")\\n    route = (params.get(\\"route\\") or \[\\"\\"])\[0] or urlparse(target).path.removeprefix(\\"/api/\\").strip(\\"/\\")\\n    try:\\n        if route == \\"health\\":\\n            payload, status = health(), 200\\n        elif route == \\"feed\\":\\n            payload, status = feed\_view(params), 200\\n        elif route == \\"ledger\\":\\n            payload, status = ledger\_view(params), 200\\n        elif route in (\\"alerts/config\\", \\"alerts\\"):\\n            payload, status = alert\_config(), 200\\n        else:\\n            payload, status = {\\"error\\": \\"not found\\"}, 404\\n    except ValueError as exc:\\n        payload, status = {\\"error\\": str(exc)\[:160]}, 400\\n    except Exception as exc:\\n        payload, status = {\\"error\\": type(exc).\_\_name\_\_}, 500\\n    \_write(response, status, \_body(payload))\\n\\n\\ndef \_body(payload: dict) -> bytes:\\n    return json.dumps(payload).encode()\\n\\n\\ndef \_write(response, status: int, body: bytes) -> None:\\n    response.status\_code = status\\n    headers = response.headers\\n    headers\[\\"Content-Type\\"] = \\"application/json\\"\\n    headers\[\\"Access-Control-Allow-Origin\\"] = \\"\*\\"\\n    headers\[\\"Access-Control-Allow-Methods\\"] = \\"GET, OPTIONS\\"\\n    headers\[\\"Access-Control-Allow-Headers\\"] = \\"Content-Type\\"\\n    headers\[\\"Cache-Control\\"] = \\"no-store\\"\\n    response.body = body\\n"}

{"path":"D:\\\\Enam Project\\\\finn\_build\\\\finn\\\\finn\_core\\\\ledger.py","streamContent":"def quote\_check(evidence: str, low: float | None, high: float | None, unit: str | None = None) -> str:\\n    \\"\\"\\"Whether these numbers, and their unit, are actually in the stored quote.\\"\\"\\"\\n    if low is None and high is None:\\n        return \\"ok\\"\\n    stated = read\_unit(evidence, low, high)\\n    if unit and stated != unit:\\n        return f\\"The quote states {stated}, not {unit}.\\"\\n    if stated == \\"other\\":\\n        return \\"The quote does not state the unit.\\"\\n    text = re.sub(r\\"\\\\s\*-\\\\s\*\\", \\"-\\", (evidence or \\"\\").lower())\\n    missing = \[]\\n    for value in (low, high):\\n        if value is None or \_number\_in\_text(text, value) or \_from\_named\_band(text, value):\\n            continue\\n        missing.append(f\\"{value:g}\\")\\n    if not missing:\\n        return \\"ok\\"\\n    return \\"Not in the quote: \\" + \\", \\".join(missing)\\n\\n\\ndef read\_unit(evidence: str, low: float | None, high: float | None) -> str:\\n    \\"\\"\\"Unit of these numbers, read from the quote. A model label does not decide it.\\"\\"\\"\\n    text = re.sub(r\\"\\\\s\*-\\\\s\*\\", \\"-\\", (evidence or \\"\\").lower())\\n    spans = \[]\\n    for value in (low, high):\\n        spans.extend(\_number\_spans(text, value))\\n    if not spans:\\n        return \\"percent\\" if \_from\_named\_band(text, low) or \_from\_named\_band(text, high) else \\"other\\"\\n    start = max(0, min(span\[0] for span in spans) - 20)\\n    end = min(len(text), max(span\[1] for span in spans) + 32)\\n    window = text\[start:end]\\n    if re.search(r\\"\\\\$|\\\\busd\\\\b|u\\\\.s\\\\. dollar|us dollar|\\\\bdollars?\\\\b\\", window):\\n        return \\"currency\_usd\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"basis points?|\\\\bbps\\\\b\\", window):\\n        return \\"bps\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"%|percent\\", window):\\n        return \\"percent\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"\\\\binr\\\\b|₹|\\\\bcrores?\\\\b|\\\\blakhs?\\\\b|\\\\brupees?\\\\b|\\\\brs\\\\.?\\\\b\\", window):\\n        return \\"currency\_inr\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"\\\\d+(?:\\\\.\\\\d+)?\\\\s\*x\\\\b\\", window):\\n        return \\"ratio\\"\\n    if \_from\_named\_band(text, low) or \_from\_named\_band(text, high):\\n        return \\"percent\\"\\n    return \\"other\\"\\n\\n\\ndef read\_kind(unit: str, metric\_key: str, evidence: str) -> str:\\n    \\"\\"\\"A growth rate or a basis-point move is a change. An amount or a margin percent is a level.\\"\\"\\"\\n    if unit == \\"bps\\":\\n        return \\"change\\"\\n    if unit in (\\"currency\_usd\\", \\"currency\_inr\\", \\"count\\", \\"ratio\\"):\\n        return \\"level\\"\\n    if unit == \\"percent\\" and metric\_key in (\\"revenue\_growth\\", \\"ebitda\_growth\\", \\"pat\_growth\\", \\"volume\_growth\\"):\\n        return \\"change\\"\\n    if unit == \\"percent\\" and re.search(r\\"(expand|improv|increase|decrease|reduc).{0,40}(percent|%)\\", evidence or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"change\\"\\n    return \\"level\\""}

{"path":"D:\\\\Enam Project\\\\finn\_build\\\\finn\\\\finn\_core\\\\ledger.py","streamContent":"def \_promise\_line(promise: dict, low, high, unit: str = \\"percent\\", evidence: str = \\"\\") -> str:\\n    label = LABELS.get(promise\[\\"metric\_key\\"], promise\[\\"metric\_key\\"])\\n    if unit in (\\"currency\_usd\\", \\"currency\_inr\\") and promise\[\\"metric\_key\\"] == \\"revenue\_growth\\":\\n        label = \\"Revenue\\"\\n    target = \_target\_phrase(low, high, unit, evidence)\\n    if target == \\"a direction only\\":\\n        if promise.get(\\"direction\\") == \\"down\\":\\n            target = \\"to fall\\"\\n        elif promise.get(\\"direction\\") == \\"up\\":\\n            target = \\"to rise\\"\\n    period = promise.get(\\"target\_period\\") or \\"an unnamed period\\"\\n    return f\\"{label} {target} for {period}\\"\\n\\n\\ndef \_target\_phrase(low, high, unit: str = \\"percent\\", evidence: str = \\"\\") -> str:\\n    scale = \_scale\_word(evidence, unit)\\n    if unit == \\"bps\\":\\n        prefix, suffix = \\"\\", \\" bps\\"\\n    elif unit == \\"currency\_usd\\":\\n        prefix, suffix = \\"US$\\", scale\\n    elif unit == \\"currency\_inr\\":\\n        prefix, suffix = \\"₹\\", scale\\n    elif unit == \\"percent\\":\\n        prefix, suffix = \\"\\", \\"%\\"\\n    else:\\n        prefix, suffix = \\"\\", \\"\\"\\n    if low is not None and high is not None and abs(low - high) < 1e-6:\\n        return f\\"{prefix}{low:g}{suffix}\\"\\n    if low is not None and high is not None:\\n        return f\\"{prefix}{low:g}–{high:g}{suffix}\\"\\n    if low is not None:\\n        return f\\"at least {prefix}{low:g}{suffix}\\"\\n    if high is not None:\\n        return f\\"at most {prefix}{high:g}{suffix}\\"\\n    return \\"a direction only\\"\\n\\n\\ndef \_scale\_word(evidence: str, unit: str) -> str:\\n    text = (evidence or \\"\\").lower()\\n    if unit == \\"currency\_usd\\":\\n        if \\"billion\\" in text:\\n            return \\" billion\\"\\n        if \\"million\\" in text:\\n            return \\" million\\"\\n    if unit == \\"currency\_inr\\":\\n        if \\"crore\\" in text:\\n            return \\" crore\\"\\n        if \\"lakh\\" in text:\\n            return \\" lakh\\"\\n    return \\"\\""}

{"path":"D:\\\\Enam Project\\\\finn\_build\\\\finn\\\\web\\\\src\\\\components\\\\Research.tsx","streamContent":"function progressLine(progress: LedgerProgress | null, busy: boolean, transcripts: number | null): string {\\n  if (!progress) return 'Finding filings'\\n  const { stage, done, total } = progress\\n  if (stage === 'discover') {\\n    if (busy) return 'Reading results'\\n    return total ? `Found ${done} of ${total} transcripts` : 'Finding transcripts'\\n  }\\n  if (stage === 'series') {\\n    if (busy) return transcripts ? `Reading transcript 1 of ${transcripts}` : 'Reading transcript 1'\\n    return total ? `Reading results, ${done} of ${total} quarters` : 'Reading results'\\n  }\\n  if (stage === 'guidance') {\\n    const count = total || transcripts || 0\\n    const reading = busy ? Math.min(count || 1, done + 1) : Math.max(done, 1)\\n    return `Reading transcript ${reading} of ${count || '…'}`\\n  }\\n  if (stage === 'complete') return 'Done'\\n  return 'Reading the filings'\\n}\\n\\nfunction barFraction(progress: LedgerProgress | null, busy: boolean, transcripts: number | null): number {\\n  if (!progress) return busy ? 0.08 : 0\\n  if (progress.stage === 'complete') return 1\\n  if (progress.stage === 'discover') return busy ? 0.3 : 0.16\\n  if (progress.stage === 'series') {\\n    const count = transcripts || 1\\n    return busy ? 0.3 + (1 / count) \* 0.68 : 0.3\\n  }\\n  if (progress.stage === 'guidance') {\\n    const total = progress.total || transcripts || 1\\n    const done = Math.min(total, progress.done + (busy ? 1 : 0))\\n    return 0.3 + (done / total) \* 0.68\\n  }\\n  return 0.08\\n}"}

\## Assistant



The dollar range is no longer scored. A promise is scored only when the quote itself states a unit the consolidated rupee series can check. `4f3011d` is on `main`. The API and the web app are both redeployed.



The Wipro sentence gives a revenue level in dollars, `$2.571 billion to $2.625 billion`. Those numbers are under 100, so they were kept and then treated as a percent. Every promise now carries a unit read from the quote — percent, bps, currency\_usd, currency\_inr, count, ratio, or other — and a kind, level or change. Growth is scored only from a percent in the quote. A margin is scored only from a percent or from basis points. `quote\_check` has to find that unit on those numbers, not only the digits. Dollars are left unscored: “Guided in US dollars for the IT services segment; our series is consolidated INR.” Constant-currency wording, including the hyphenated form, is unscored for the same reason. Segment guidance stays `segment\_level`.



The ledger tests cover that Wipro quote, the Pidilite “200 bps” gross-margin quote, and the Marico and Asian Paints scored rows. All 26 ledger, results, and document tests pass.



Re-judged from cache, at 0 guidance tokens:



| Ticker | Scored | Result |

| --- | ---: | --- |

| MARICO | 3 | Unchanged: +144 bps on track, revenue 16.51% ahead of at least 10%, EBITDA growth 25.76% ahead of 17–19%. |

| ASIANPAINT | 2 | Unchanged: FY2026 18.37% delivered, FY2027 18.16% on track. |

| TITAN, PIDILITIND, CGPOWER, DMART | 0 | Unchanged. |

| WIPRO | 0 | The dollar sentence that came back is `$2.505 billion to $2.557 billion`, unit `currency\_usd`, kind level, not scored. |



Fresh reads outside the demo set: INFY 3, HINDUNILVR 2, SBIN 0, BRITANNIA 0. Three scored rows are worth a look, and they were left scored. Infosys “1.5% to 3%” does not say constant currency in the stored sentence, and half-year rupee growth was 12.32%. Hindustan Unilever’s “Ice Cream demerger is expected to result in an improvement of 50–60 bps” is a separation, and the half-year margin moved −52 bps. Asian’s two rows still quote PBDIT and are scored as EBITDA margin, as before.



While a ledger request is in flight, the label is now the step being read. After results, the first guidance call says “Reading transcript 1 of 7”.



Live `GET /api/ledger?symbol=WIPRO` returns `source=cache`, the verdict that nothing consolidated can be checked, and 0 scored rows. The dollar row is not scored. The web app at https://web-eosin-ten-23.vercel.app is the build with the label fix.

A neighboring sentence does not.\\"\\"\\"\\n    text = \_basis\_window(passage or \\"\\", quote or \\"\\")\\n    if re.search(r\\"constant\[- ]currency\\", text, re.I):\\n        return \\"constant\_currency\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"pro\[- ]?forma\\", text, re.I):\\n        return \\"pro\_forma\\"\\n    basis = str(stated or \\"\\").strip().lower().replace(\\" \\", \\"\_\\")\\n    if basis in (\\"reported\\", \\"constant\_currency\\", \\"pro\_forma\\", \\"other\\", \\"not\_stated\\"):\\n        return basis\\n    return \\"not\_stated\\"\\n\\n\\ndef \_basis\_window(passage: str, quote: str) -> str:\\n    text = \\" \\".join((passage or \\"\\").split())\\n    needle = \\" \\".join((quote or \\"\\").split())\\n    if not text or not needle:\\n        return text or needle\\n    sentences = \[part for part in re.split(r\\"(?<=\[.!?])\\\\s+(?=\[A-Z])\\", text) if part]\\n    key = needle\[:80].lower()\\n    for sentence in sentences:\\n        if key\[:40] in sentence.lower() or sentence.lower()\[:40] in key:\\n            return sentence\\n    return needle"}

\## Assistant



The passage is checked before a row can be scored. Commit `c4e3d64` is on `main`, the demo ledgers were rewritten at 0 tokens, and the API is live at https://finn-r4y3.vercel.app.



A row that arithmetic would score now goes to a second Gemini call with the quote and about three sentences either side. The call returns `consolidated`, `reported\_basis`, `independent\_of\_named\_event`, and `metric\_named`, each with an evidence quote. A false flag makes the row `not\_scored`. A general condition such as “subject to stable macros” stays on the row as a caveat. Constant currency in the promise’s own sentence sets `basis`. A neighboring sentence about a different business does not. If the same filing has already stated consolidated revenue guidance in constant currency, a later sentence that drops the words keeps that basis. An event blocks the score only when it qualifies this quote.



`gemini-3.6-flash` and `gemini-3.8-flash` were both at the free 20-request daily cap, with a retry about 16 hours out. The verifier used `gemini-3-flash-preview`, and `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` when that model was busy. Results are cached as `guidance\_verify` version `v2`. Guidance extraction stays on `v3`.



\*\*Marico, 3 scored.\*\* Verifier: 5 calls, 10,477 tokens, all `gemini-3-flash-preview`. Every flag true.



\- EBITDA margin 140–150 bps for FY2027, `tracking\_on\_track`, actual +144 bps. H1 margin 19.46% versus 18.02%. Basis `not\_stated`. Quote: “EBITDA margin would expand in the range of about 140 to 150 basis points.”

\- Revenue growth at least 10% for FY2027, `tracking\_ahead`, actual 16.51%. H1 revenue 7,854 versus 6,741. Caveat on the row: “global supply chain disruptions”. That phrase is scene-setting in the passage, and the score stands.

\- EBITDA growth 17–19% for FY2027, `tracking\_ahead`, actual 25.76%. H1 EBITDA 1,528 versus 1,215. Caveat: “subject to stable macros”.



\*\*Asian Paints, 2 scored.\*\* Verifier: 4 calls, 6,063 tokens. Every flag true. Both rows carry `definition\_note`: “Company says PBDIT; we compute EBITDA excluding other income.”



\- EBITDA margin 18–20% for FY2027, `tracking\_on\_track`, actual 18.16% (17.91% a year earlier, +25 bps). Quote: “We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds.”

\- EBITDA margin 18–20% for FY2026, `delivered`, actual 18.37%. Quote: “maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band.” The passage also gives the standalone Q2 margin of 18.5% and the consolidated level “closer to 18%”. The verifier kept the promise consolidated.



\*\*Infosys.\*\* Verifier: 10 calls, 10,033 tokens. Two rows stayed scored, both operating margin 20–22%, every flag true.



\- FY2026, `partly`, actual 22.94%. Quote: “Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.”

\- FY2027, `tracking\_ahead`, actual 23.70% versus 23.60% (+10 bps). Quote: “Our operating margin guidance is 20% to 22%.”



The 1.5% to 3% revenue row is `not\_scored`. The revision page itself does not say constant currency:



> Considering lower-than-expected Q1 revenues and revised view of the rest of the year, we are revising our revenue guidance to 1.5% to 3%. This includes approximately 1.7% contribution from recently closed acquisitions of Optimum Healthcare and Stratus, slightly over 1% impact from a large European manufacturing client, and approximately 0.75% to 1% impact from the shift towards offshore. The lower end of the guidance assumes further deterioration in macro.



The verifier, given that passage, returned `reported\_basis` true. The same filing, earlier, says “we are changing our revenue growth guidance to 1.5% to 3% Y-on-Y growth in constant currency terms.” The row’s basis is `constant\_currency`, and the note is “The same filing states this revenue guidance in constant currency.” H1 rupee growth of 12.32% is not compared with that band.



\*\*Hindustan Unilever.\*\* Verifier: 2 calls, 1,523 tokens, `gemini-3.5-flash-lite`.



\- EBITDA margin 22.5–23.5% for FY2027 stayed scored, `tracking\_behind`, actual 22.39% versus 22.91% (−52 bps). Every flag true. The quote says “mid-term”, and the ledger mapped that to FY2027.

\- The 50–60 bps row is `not\_scored`. `independent\_of\_named\_event` is false. `conditional\_on` is “Ice Cream demerger”. Quote: “Ice Cream demerger is expected to result in an improvement of 50-60 bps to the reported margin.” The passage adds that the ice-cream business operates at a margin lower than the HUL average, and that the demerger would add 50–60 bps to the 22–23% near- to mid-term guidance.



\*\*Unseen tickers, scored rows: 0 each.\*\* Nestlé had one transcript. Dabur, UltraTech, and Bajaj Auto say “growth” without naming revenue or EBITDA in the sentence, so those lines stay low confidence. HCLTech and Tech Mahindra state revenue guidance in constant currency, or as services, or as EBIT margin. Fresh guidance reads for the six were about 145,000 Flash-Lite tokens. HCLTech’s verifier was 2 calls, 1,535 tokens.



Two HCL lines are worth a look. “At the Company level the revenue growth is expected to be between 2.5% to 4%” is the same sentence as “For FY27, constant currency revenue growth is expected to be between 3% to 4% for the Services business.” The verifier called the short quote reported. The sentence set `constant\_currency`, so the row is not scored. A second sentence, “Our FY27 growth guidance is now 2.5% to 4%, and our EBIT margin guidance remains at 17.5% to 18.5%,” does not say constant currency. It was left unscored because the sentence is an EBIT margin, which is not the consolidated EBITDA series.

EBITDA and PBDIT stay on EBITDA. A bare margin is not scored.\\"\\"\\"\\n    family = \_margin\_family(quote, passage)\\n    if family == \\"ebit\\":\\n        return \\"ebit\_margin\\", False\\n    if family == \\"ebitda\\" and key in (\\"ebitda\_margin\\", \\"ebit\_margin\\", \\"\\"):\\n        return \\"ebitda\_margin\\", False\\n    if family == \\"unclear\\" and key in (\\"ebitda\_margin\\", \\"ebit\_margin\\", \\"\\"):\\n        return key or \\"ebitda\_margin\\", True\\n    return key, False\\n\\n\\ndef \_margin\_family(quote: str, passage: str) -> str:\\n    if re.search(r\\"\\\\bebitda\\\\b|\\\\bpbdit\\\\b\\", quote or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"ebitda\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"operating margin|\\\\bebit margin\\\\b\\", quote or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"ebit\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"\\\\bebitda\\\\b|\\\\bpbdit\\\\b\\", passage or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"ebitda\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"operating margin|\\\\bebit margin\\\\b\\", passage or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"ebit\\"\\n    if re.search(r\\"\\\\bmargin\\\\b\\", quote or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"unclear\\"\\n    return \\"\\"\\n\\n\\ndef \_definition\_note(key: str, evidence: str) -> str:\\n    if key == \\"ebitda\_margin\\" and re.search(r\\"\\\\bpbdit\\\\b\\", evidence or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"Company says PBDIT; we compute EBITDA excluding other income\\"\\n    if key == \\"ebit\_margin\\" and re.search(r\\"operating margin\\", evidence or \\"\\", re.I):\\n        return \\"Company says operating margin; we compute EBIT as PBT + finance costs − other income, as a percent of revenue.\\"\\n    if key == \\"ebit\_margin\\":\\n        return \\"Company says EBIT margin; we compute EBIT as PBT + finance costs − other income, as a percent of revenue.\\"\\n    return \\"\\"\\n\\n\\ndef \_explicit\_period(passage: str, call\_period: str):\\n    \\"\\"\\"A named fiscal year or 'this year' can be scored. Mid-term and near-term cannot, unless a year is also named.\\"\\"\\"\\n    text = passage or \\"\\"\\n    match = \_EXPLICIT\_FY.search(text)\\n    if match:\\n        raw = next(group for group in match.groups() if group)\\n        year = int(raw)\\n        if year < 100:\\n            year += 2000\\n        return \\"fiscal\_year\\", date(year, 3, 31)\\n    if \_THIS\_YEAR.search(text):\\n        try:\\n            call = date.fromisoformat(call\_period\[:10])\\n        except ValueError:\\n            return None\\n        year = call.year if call.month <= 3 else call.year + 1\\n        return \\"fiscal\_year\\", date(year, 3, 31)\\n    if \_VAGUE\_HORIZON.search(text):\\n        return \\"vague\\"\\n    return None\\n\\n\\ndef \_infer\_metric(evidence: str) -> str | None:"}

\## Infosys: the 22.94% and 23.70% were EBITDA



EBITDA is `(PBT + finance costs + depreciation − other income) / revenue`.



FY2026, four quarters to 31 Mar 2026: EBITDA 40,990 on revenue 1,78,650 = \*\*22.94%\*\*. H1 FY2027 (June and September 2026): EBITDA 23,098 on revenue 97,455 = \*\*23.70%\*\*, against 23.60% a year earlier.



EBIT leaves depreciation in: `PBT + finance costs − other income`.



FY2026: EBIT 36,089 on the same revenue = \*\*20.20%\*\*, inside 20–22%, so that row is now \*\*delivered\*\*. One quarter check: March 2026 is 10,797 + 105 − 1,159 = 9,743. Both quotes say “operating margin”. The definition note on each row is: company says operating margin; EBIT is PBT + finance costs − other income, as a percent of revenue. The 1.5–3% revenue revision stays unscored, because the same filing states it in constant currency.

The briefing polish is on main as `9f6f0d7` and live at \[web-eosin-ten-23.vercel.app](https://web-eosin-ten-23.vercel.app). The deployment `dpl\_8bce2sDMG2phAhTTiJN5XRjfXDFT` is Ready and serving this build. The API was left as it was. No new model tokens were spent.



\*\*How FINN works.\*\* The sheet was a flex column with only a max height, so the body collapsed to the “1 of 3” line, and it opened under the menu that was still closing. It now scrolls as a whole, with the header stuck, and sits above that menu. First run and the menu reopen both show the title, the description, and Next, Back, and Done for all three steps, in light and dark, at 390×844. That holds on the live site as well.



\*\*Results card.\*\* Revenue, EBITDA, PBT, and PAT are a 2×2 grid, each with its value and QoQ/YoY chips. A tap opens the three bars, captioned “yr ago – prev qtr – now”. Titan’s line is “Revenue +10.1% YoY, PAT +113.7% YoY. EBITDA margin 14.5%, +4.5 pts YoY.” Bharat Forge PAT quarter-on-quarter says “swung to profit”. Both cards carry the large-swing note, because PAT year-on-year is past ±100% and Bharat Forge’s quarter-on-quarter base is negative. Source links read XBRL filing, Investor presentation, and Outcome of board meeting PDF. The date control reads “6 Nov 2026”. At 390×844 the lead card, takeaway and links included, sits above the tab bar in both themes.



\*\*Ledgers, from cache, 0 tokens.\*\* Marico shows the three scored rows: EBITDA margin +144 bps inside 140–150, revenue 16.51% ahead of at least 10%, EBITDA growth 25.76% ahead of 17–19%. HCLTech’s FY2026 EBIT row is borderline: 16.44% against 17–18%, with the derived-figure line. Infosys operating margin 20–22% is not scored, with both readings: FY2026 EBIT 20.2% inside and EBITDA 22.94% above; FY2027 EBIT 21.03% inside and EBITDA 23.7% above. Those two now have a complete cached snapshot, so the next open returns immediately.

A stored series of 21 or more sessions is kept.\\n\\n    A later download replaces stored bars only when it is at least as long.\\n    A failed or short download does not wipe a longer series.\\n    \\"\\"\\"\\n    kept: dict\[str, list\[dict]] = {}\\n    short: dict\[str, list\[dict]] = {}\\n    missing: list\[str] = \[]\\n    for symbol in symbols:\\n        rows = \_read\_bars(cache, symbol, start, end)\\n        if len(rows) >= EOD\_ENOUGH:\\n            kept\[symbol] = rows\\n        else:\\n            short\[symbol] = rows\\n            missing.append(symbol)\\n    fresh: dict\[str, list\[dict]] = {}\\n    error = None\\n    if missing:\\n        try:\\n            fresh = fetch\_eod(missing, start, end)\\n        except Exception as exc:\\n            error = f\\"{type(exc).\_\_name\_\_}: {exc}\\"\\n    out: dict\[str, list\[dict]] = {}\\n    for symbol in symbols:\\n        if symbol in kept:\\n            out\[symbol] = kept\[symbol]\\n            continue\\n        got = fresh.get(symbol) or \[]\\n        old = short.get(symbol) or \[]\\n        if got and len(got) >= len(old):\\n            \_write\_bars(cache, symbol, start, end, got)\\n            out\[symbol] = got\\n        else:\\n            out\[symbol] = old\\n    return out, error\\n\\n\\ndef fetch\_eod(symbols: list\[str], start: date, end: date) -> dict\[str, list\[dict]]:"}

\## Assistant



The default 6 Nov, 72-hour feed is one list of eight movers. The three on the phone are that same window with the volume multiple set to 8.



`/api/feed?as\_of=2026-11-06\&hours=72` and the same URL with `move\_pct=5\&volume\_n=2.5` share the cache key `2026-11-06|72|5|2.5|\*`. Both return eight alerts, in this order: MARICO 3 Nov +10.0% (8.17×), BAJFINANCE 5 Nov +7.65% (3.45×), CGPOWER 6 Nov −4.43% (5.12×), TITAN 6 Nov +3.42% (5.55×), BHARATFORG 5 Nov −3.30% (4.75×), MARUTI 5 Nov +5.48% (2.59×), MARICO 4 Nov +1.32% (2.56×), SUNPHARMA 4 Nov +0.20% (2.80×). A fresh load of the app requests that URL. Its starting state is 72 hours, 5%, and 2.5×.



The three-mover feed was stored today at 05:53 UTC with the same date, the same 5% move, and a volume multiple of 8. At 8× the five volume-only chips drop, leaving MARICO 3 Nov, BAJFINANCE 5 Nov, and MARUTI 5 Nov. The summary and the strip both use that list, so one response stays in agreement. Two screenshots differed because they were two thresholds. The strip now says which one it used (“Above 5% or 2.5× volume.”), and the settings sheet can return to 5% and 2.5×. Order is severity, then symbol, then date. A pinned replay is served from the snapshot file if the cache misses, and a stored price series of 21 or more sessions is kept if a later download is shorter.



A query with no reasonable listed match shows only “No listed company found”. “wipro” still offers Wipro Limited (WIPRO).



The warmer read NSE’s Nifty 50 file (50 names), added the 18 portfolio names and the four ad-hoc names, and deduped to 59. It stopped on INDIGO when every provider returned the daily limit. INDIGO was not saved as complete. Seventeen names were not started, and a later run skips the finished ones. Stage lines sum to \*\*595,421 tokens\*\*. Supabase holds \*\*1,965 cache rows and 35.0 MB\*\* of payload JSON, against the 500 MB free limit. The snapshot files are 42 ledgers, 0.9 MB. New scored rows: TCS 1, BEL 3, CIPLA 3, DRREDDY 1. MARICO 3, HCLTECH 2, and ASIANPAINT 2 were already stored and were left as they were. Scoring was not changed.

\## Assistant



`CRON\_SECRET` is the variable. It is already set on the API project, Production only. To see or rotate it: Vercel → team \*\*nightguy716s-projects\*\* → project \*\*finn-r4y3\*\* (the API, not web) → \*\*Settings\*\* → \*\*Environment Variables\*\* → \*\*Production\*\*.



The morning job is `GET /api/cron/daily`. Vercel runs it at `30 3 \* \* \*`, which is 09:00 IST, and sends the secret as a Bearer token. A wrong or missing token returns 401. The handler writes a heartbeat so Supabase stays awake, then stores today’s 24h and 72h feeds for the 18 portfolio names. A cold attempt hit the 60-second limit before either window was saved. The job now does one exchange sweep and stores the 72-hour feed before it builds the 24-hour one from the same filings. The complete file opened with pypdf: ready, year 2026, 3,648 tokens, 43.4 seconds cold, 0.2 seconds cached. Page 163 states the single Food segment and the product groups Milk Products and Nutrition, Prepared Dishes and Cooking Aids, Powdered and Liquid Beverages, and Confectionery. The extracted opening "unlocks the power of food" is not on that page; the field stayed because the segment sentence on the same page has a six-word run. PyMuPDF 1.26.4 is the fallback when pypdf cannot list pages, for annual reports and transcripts, with page numbers kept. The installed tree is about 51 MB. The production API build completed, so it fits the function limit.



\*\*What is computed.\*\* No model call. All seven are consolidated half-years, 1 Apr 2026 to 30 Sep 2026, against the 31 Mar 2026 balance sheet. Figures are INR crore. Cash is the `CashAndCashEquivalents` tag only, not other bank balances. Debt is current plus non-current borrowings when both tags exist. Debt-to-equity is that debt divided by `Equity`. Net debt is debt minus that cash. Working capital is inventories plus current and non-current trade receivables minus current and non-current trade payables. A missing half of a split is left as not available. Cash conversion is operating cash flow divided by profit for the same half-year. Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus purchases of property, plant and equipment and of intangibles. Both purchase tags are required. Banks, NBFCs and insurers are marked not meaningful for debt-to-equity, net debt and working capital.
